cs.t: If you have carpal tunnel issues, I can highly recommend the RollerMouse RED. It’s not a trackball, but a unique rolling bar controller that I’ve been using for several years now with none of the RSS issues I used to have. Not the cheapest option for sure, but the least physically stressful input device I’ve ever used.
